title: 📊 CMake error message

[dok@q7 qt6-build]$ ../qt6/configure -prefix ~/opt
+ mkdir -p qtbase
+ cd qtbase
+ exec /home/dok/repos/qt6/qtbase/configure -top-level -prefix /home/dok/opt
CMake Warning (dev) at /home/dok/repos/qt6/qtbase/cmake/QtBuildInformation.cmake:239 (set):
  Cannot set "__qt_configure_reports": current scope has no parent.
Call Stack (most recent call first):
  /home/dok/repos/qt6/qtsensors/src/sensors/configure.cmake:45 (qt_configure_add_report)
  /home/dok/repos/qt6/qtbase/cmake/QtProcessConfigureArgs.cmake:240 (include)
This warning is for project developers.  Use -Wno-dev to suppress it.

CMake Error at /home/dok/repos/qt6/qtwebengine/configure.cmake:63 (check_for_ulimit):
  Unknown CMake command "check_for_ulimit".
Call Stack (most recent call first):
  /home/dok/repos/qt6/qtbase/cmake/QtProcessConfigureArgs.cmake:240 (include)

It seems like there's an issue with the Qt configuration process. The error message indicates that there's an unknown CMake command "check_for_ulimit" in the qtwebengine configure file.

To resolve this, I would suggest checking if the CMake version being used is compatible with the Qt version. It's possible that the check_for_ulimit command was introduced in a later version of CMake.

Additionally, the warning about setting "__qt_configure_reports" can be suppressed by adding the -Wno-dev flag to the configure command.

Here's a revised command:

`../qt6/configure -prefix ~/opt -Wno-dev`

If the issue persists, it might be necessary to update CMake or provide more information about the environment and versions being used.
